rules.message: Browser alert/confirm/prompt dialogs are not allowed. Use inline, specific messages and the project's dialog component.
Raw colors in components bypass the theme. Use the project's color tokens.
Raw color outside a token definition. Define it as a token once and reference it.
Arbitrary pixel sizes break the type and spacing scale. Use the project's scale.
Inline font sizes bypass the type scale.
!important hides a specificity problem. Fix the cascade instead.
Native select controls rarely match the product's finish. Prefer the project's picker component when one exists.
Marketing cliche in product copy. Say plainly what the person gets.
